summary: Shows the ternary filter returning one value for true and another for false (1.9+), plus a third value for null (2.8+).
questions: Is there an inline if/else filter in Ansible?
How do I pick a value based on a boolean in Jinja2?
How do I handle a null value with ternary?

answer_card.title: The ternary filter
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ (status == 'needs_restart') | ternary('restart', 'continue') }}
```

With a third value for null (2.8+):

```jinja
{{ enabled | ternary('no shutdown', 'shutdown', omit) }}
```
